title: Reframe workspace to standalone local-canonical mode
description:
Reframe repo so all customizations work locally without upstream push rights. Concrete changes:

1. Beads sync.remote: comment out (disable Dolt remote sync entirely). Local Dolt DB stays authoritative.
2. Add scripts/export-state.sh: bundles git history + bd export + .beads/issues.jsonl into a single portable artifact.
3. Add scripts/setup-fork.sh: idempotent script that points origin at a personal fork (if configured) and pushes.
4. Update CLAUDE.md to document the local-canonical pattern.
5. Update .devcontainer/on-create.sh to be fork-aware (clone from configured fork if set, else default remote).
6. All 8 previously-committed CI workflows remain unchanged (they're already push-free). Verification: bd dolt push still rejected (no change), but bd dolt pull is also skipped so no surface for the 403.

Verification:
- bd ready / bd list works locally (no remote needed)
- git bundle create round-trips: git clone bundle.bundle -b main /tmp/restore
- bd export produces valid JSONL that restores via bd import
- All workflows still valid against local bd state
- No new commits upstream of origin/main

title: Resolve push credential 403 for CodeAgentMobile/codeam-codespace
description:
git push and bd dolt push both fail with HTTP 403: 'Permission to CodeAgentMobile/codeam-codespace.git denied to benholl94-cmyk'. The credential helper is set (/.codespaces/bin/gitcredential_github.sh + store) and the user identity resolves (benholl94-cmyk is a recognized GitHub user), but the authenticated identity lacks write access to the target repo.

Local state: 8 commits ahead of origin/main on branch main, working tree clean. Nothing lost — all work is preserved locally and can be pushed once a credential with write access is available.

Resolution paths:
1. Confirm whether benholl94-cmyk should have push access; if not, request collaborator/maintainer role from a repo admin.
2. If this is intentionally a read-only workspace, the local commits must be exported (e.g., bundle file, patch series, or PR from a fork) for someone with write access to land them.
3. If a personal fork should receive the work, add it as a remote: git remote add fork git@github.com:benholl94-cmyk/codeam-codespace.git && git push fork main
